description:
Remove the per-multiply reducer lookup and allocation from scalar `Gf2mWide` multiplication.

## Background

`Gf2mWide::mul_ref` fetches its Barrett reducer through `get_reducer` (`crates/gf2-core/src/gf2m/wide.rs`), which locks a global `HashMap` keyed by `(TypeId, N)` and clones a heap-allocated reducer on every scalar multiply. A perf profile of `FieldMatrix` PLE, inverse and solve over `Gf2mWide<1, _>` attributes about 45% of samples to hashing, allocation and free, and makes those operations 50–70 times slower than over `Fp` at the same dimension; `gemm` is unaffected.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Scalar `Gf2mWide` multiplication performs no heap allocation and no global-map lookup per call, verified by a test or allocation counter over repeated multiplies.
- [hard] REQ-02: The shared field-law suite and existing `Gf2mWide` tests pass unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: A committed benchmark receipt from a prepared host reports `FieldMatrix` PLE time over a `Gf2mWide<1, _>` field before and after the change.
title: Hoist the Barrett reducer out of scalar Gf2mWide multiply
